title: Owned Original Borrowed Graph Validation
birth: Actual original grants move a genuine immutable reader into its exact Box and a private shared stable owner containing that reader and its key index; every backing byte is quoted before allocation
reader: The concrete owner retains genuine source aliases and paid indexed field descriptors; its graph is immutable until continuation and key index close
close: Reader Box and final shared stable-owner backing
laws: No stack or movable-field pointer survives a turn
Zero-credit turns never poll the continuation
Every child demand adds own overhead and subtracts actual original remaining grant
Semantic success and refusal both require fully closed reader before preflight publication
Cancellation uses the identical funded close frontier
continuation: The pinned asynchronous continuation owns a private strong alias and obtains graph and key-slot borrows inside its body; no erased static reference is manufactured
